author: The Linux Foundation
description:
Bianca Lewis, Executive Director of the OpenSearch Software Foundation, explains why vendor lock-in is now the defining risk for data infrastructure teams managing AI workloads at scale.

Full article and transcript: https://tfir.io/vendor-lock-in-data-infrastructure-opensearch/

Unpredictable AI token costs, sudden vendor pricing changes, and tightening data sovereignty regulations like CRA are forcing organizations to rethink proprietary data infrastructure. The stakes are not theoretical: a forced re-architecture mid-growth can break a business model entirely.

In this exclusive interview with Swapnil Bhartiya, Bianca Lewis, Executive Director of the OpenSearch Software Foundation, makes the case for open, sovereign data infrastructure as the only safe foundation in a period of deep uncertainty around AI scale costs and compliance demands.

Key Topics Covered:
- Why 71% of organizations now prioritize deploying independently of any single vendor
- How unpredictable AI workload cost
title: Vendor Lock-In Is the Biggest Risk to Your Data Infrastructure | Bianca Lewis
